tools.name: luke_send_to_claude
tools.description: Sends an order to the main Claude Code chat of the focused session. It is the only way to act on the user's computer (read code, search a repository, run a command, change files): never a subagent. Call it only after you said the order back in one sentence and the user clearly said yes. Before it reaches the chat, luke-voice refines the order with Prompt Master in one quick model call and sends only the refined prompt; if the refinement fails nothing is sent and a [news] update says so. The result arrives later in a [news] update.

prompt.description: The user's order, cleaned up, in Portuguese: what to do, where (repository, folder or file) and what to report back. Never add requirements the user did not say.

when.description: now: start it, or add it as a note to the running turn (the default). after_current: queue it until Claude is done.

session.description: The short name of the session to send to. Leave empty for the focused one.

plan.description: Never set it yourself: luke-voice asks the user 'plan first?' after the yes and fills it in. true: plan with the native plan flow, save the plan as a markdown file and send Claude its path.

tools.name: luke_stop_claude
tools.description: Stop Claude's running turn. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to stop.

session.description: The short name of the session. Leave empty for the focused one.

tools.name: luke_session_activity
tools.description: Read the latest activity of a Claude session: prompts, tool calls, failures and answers.

session.description: The short name of the session. Leave empty for the focused one.

tools.name: luke_memory_search
tools.description: Search Ceci's permanent memory: every past conversation with the user, the tasks and what the sessions did. Use it before saying you do not remember. Returns dated hits.

query.description: Words to look for, in Portuguese.

from.description: Optional start date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM.

to.description: Optional end date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM.

tools.name: luke_memory_conversation
tools.description: Read one past conversation from Ceci's memory, whole: by its number (#12), a date (YYYY-MM-DD, its first conversation that day), "first" (the very first one) or "last".

which.description: A conversation number, a date YYYY-MM-DD, "first" or "last".

offset.description: Optional: skip this many lines, to read further.

tools.name: luke_memory_timeline
tools.description: Read the summaries of past days and months from Ceci's memory, to review a period.

to.description: Optional end date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM.

tools.name: luke_memory_delete
tools.description: Delete part of Ceci's permanent memory, for good. Call it only after you said exactly what will be deleted and the user clearly said yes. Give exactly one scope.

day.description: A day YYYY-MM-DD or a month YYYY-MM.

search.description: Delete every line with these words.

agent.first_message: Oi! Eu sou a Ceci. O que vamos fazer hoje?

skip_turn.name: skip_turn
skip_turn.description: Stay silent until the user speaks again. Use it whenever there is nothing new to say: the user is quiet while a task runs, or only [activity] or [sessions] context arrived.
